content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "no", "applies_why": "The judge does not ground UNDERDETERMINED on a single verse failing to state a link or its contrary; it grounds it on the defender's dropped curse limb leaving no live link to contradict.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. This is about one verse. It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains.", "room": "a single verse does not state a link or its contrary — whether the judge's stated ground was single-verse silence (forbidden) or the defender's dropped curse limb leaving no live contradiction (not forbidden).", "why": "The judge's stated basis is the dropped curse limb and absence of a live link to contradict, not a single verse's failure to state the link or its contrary, so K-S2 does not condemn it."}
